subject: ABC factor isolation kickoff
body: Team — kickoff for the ABC factor-isolation project in vision. From our release (Learn your ABCs): approximate bijective correspondence isolates factors of variation using set supervision — train on image sets grouped by a shared factor, and the representation isolates the complementary factors. The repo gives us three tracks: Shapes3D training with mutual-information measurement via MINE to quantify exactly which generative factors the representation captures; the MNIST digit-style notebook; and pose-estimation evaluation in both dictionary-lookup and regression scenarios. Product angle: controllable-representation building blocks for the vision portfolio's editing pipeline — isolate pose from identity, style from content. Milestones: Shapes3D repro with MI measurements by May 8; pose-estimation evaluation by mid-June; integration recommendation by end of June (window closes July 6). Santiago owns staffing and the compute ask. — Lucia
